roleForm.accessHelp: How members of this role can sign in. Each is independent; a user with several roles gets every access any of them grants.

roleForm.transactionsHelp: Members may submit several Data API writes as one PostgreSQL transaction (POST /api/transactions). Each operation still needs its own permissions.
roleForm.sendEmailHelp: A workflow executed as a member may run its Send email steps. Each attachment still needs READ on its file.
roleForm.applyDefaultsHelp: What an ordinary App user needs on TotalBase's own tables - files and folders, templates, roles, their own account, sessions and activity: the same "Apply Default Permissions" as the role's page, right after it's created.

roleForm.parentHelp: The role above this one. It can do at most what its parent can, and whoever manages the parent manages it. Empty: a top-level role.
roleForm.manageRoles: Can manage the roles below it
roleForm.manageRolesHelp: Members create roles under this one, grant them permissions within what this role has, and assign them.
roleForm.reviewRequiredHelp: Its Access reviews tab reminds when a review is due, as for Administrators.

variables.user: Any column on the caller's own totalbase.users row, e.g. $USER.id or $USER.email. Unavailable for an API Key caller with no user session behind it - a filter using it then fails closed rather than matching everything.
variables.currentDate: The database's current date, with no time component.
variables.currentTime: The database's current time, with no date component.
variables.interval: A duration relative to now, e.g. $INTERVAL.7d or $INTERVAL.30m - compiles to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP minus that interval. Units: s (seconds), m (minutes), h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), y (years).
variables.period: A calendar period's start (from, inclusive) or end (to, exclusive), computed by PostgreSQL, e.g. $PERIOD.this_month.from. Periods: today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year.

permissionEditor.columnsHelp: Leave empty to grant no columns yet.
permissionEditor.rowFilterHelp: Raw filter-object JSON, same grammar as the Data API's where[...] query params. Leave empty for no restriction, e.g. {example}
permissionEditor.payloadChecksHelp: A role-scoped business-rule check on the values being written - not a PostgreSQL CHECK constraint, only enforced through TotalBase (bypassed by SQL Console or an external script). Every rule must pass (AND); each uses the same grammar as Row filter.
permissionEditor.noPayloadChecks: No payload checks - this action isn't restricted beyond Allow/Deny and Row filter.
permissionEditor.variablesHelp: $-prefixed tokens Row filter and Payload checks accept as a leaf value, resolved server-side at request time - not literal text.
permissionEditor.errorMessageHelp: Shown to the caller when this rule rejects a write. Optional - falls back to a generic message.
permissionEditor.checkHelp: Same grammar as Row filter, e.g. {example}
permissionEditor.protectedField: Never exposed through the Data API, regardless of grants - it holds a credential or internal storage detail that must never be readable or writable.
